### ① Derived judgments

- Check-runs on the head: 54, every one `success` or `skipped`, none failed or pending. `Check Changeset` is skipped under the `skip-changeset` label; `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Platform checklist gate sweep` and `Live half-state sweep` are green.
- Published surface: none. No path under `packages/**`, `skills/**`, `content/docs/**` or an `exports` map is in the diff. Right.
- Relay op table (`ops.mjs`): `issue_patch` accepts one more optional key, `type`, a closed list `Bug | Feature | Task`; `validate.mjs` refuses any other value and the key on any other op; `execute.mjs` fails an action whose 2xx answer names another type or none. An internal accept set, widened by one closed enum, with the refusal and the landed-judgement both present. Right.
- `label-write.mjs`: a new refusal (exit 2 at step ②, zero writes) on a write that changes a carried `priority:*` whose newest `labeled` event is not the fleet's. A narrowing of an internal tool, placed before the fold so both write paths pass it; `--release` changes no grade and is not affected. Right, and it matches epic comments 6982855148 item 5 and 6982933281.
- `first-touch-sweep.mjs`: one added report row and one added JSON key (`no_area`); the `owed` set, the verdict and the exit code are unchanged. Right.
- `check-half-states.mjs` H11: the `bug` label stops being an importance signal on a card that has a native type. A narrowing of a report-only row. Right for the card's "issue type first".
- `ensure-pm-labels.sh`: the objectstack area block goes from eleven rows on two repositories to eight rows on one, plus nine rows for cloud. No label object is renamed or deleted in either mode. Right.
- `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: two ceilings lowered (53 to 21, 28 to 19), none raised. Right.
- `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`: the 80 road rows at the merge base and the 80 at the head are the same set once the leading field is dropped (compared as sorted text from the two git objects). No row was lost or reworded in the regrouping.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` matches what the diff publishes, which is nothing: rule text, PM scripts, checklist `axis` fields. `Clause-②: no` is right: no published schema, export or accept set changes. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- SQL push-down: not applicable. No data-path code is in the diff. The one new read is the issue-events list in `label-write.mjs`, where the platform offers no server-side filter by event type.
- Pull request author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no other login to name.
- Dev open questions, first report: the red PR-body guard is green on this head; "Cloud-related" as the display name is kept; the `domain:cloud` row now points at `area:cloud`; the three hotcrm cross-repo mechanics are back as a pointer, and `cross-repo-coordination.md` does state all three (rule 1 with the `Blocked-by:` line, the seam-card line, the multi-lane line); the cross-repo grade sentence is narrowed to a blocked p1, as the north star words it. The retitle question is not answered: the title still names only the pm-dispatch half. It is the seat's act.
- Dev open questions, second and third reports: a fleet-sourced Feature files under category ② without the decision box (`filing-gate.md`:18); UX Features are graded by source in both texts; triage owns the weekly list; the pre-authorised carve-out is in the north star at this head ("unless pre-authorised") and agrees with `triage-duties.md`:68-69. All answered in the tree.
- **Escalated to the seat, E1 — rulings not on the record.** The cards and the epic record the maintainer's words up to 15:58Z. Five groups of later words are quoted only in this pull request's body: each repository's rules live in its own repository (16:19–16:20Z), `area:cloud` redefined without a pause (16:28–16:29Z), no card numbers or dated quotes in skill text (16:19Z), packages A and B (16:48–16:58Z), and the pick on UX Features by source (17:44Z). Three hunks contradict what the epic does record: the epic body's "`area:cloud` (hosted dependencies, paused)", 6982581146 item 3 "a Feature that improves UX defaults to p2", and 6982539552 "the cloud half folds into child 2". This review could not check those five groups against a primary record. The seat records them on epic 35205, verbatim, before the review request; the maintainer's merge is what makes them standing.
- **Escalated to the seat, E2 — the body describes another head.** The body's Verification section names `6e8f7fbf` as the final head and says the north star differs from PR 35214 by three hunks whose third reads without "unless pre-authorised". The head is `7f8e5074`, one commit later, and no `os-dev-report` on card 35207 covers it. The body is what the maintainer reads first; it is corrected before the review request.
- **For the maintainer's eye, E3 — old fleet grades read as hand-set.** The allow-list reads a user actor with no app as a person. The body's own table shows two such `priority:p1` events from 2026-08 and 2026-09 on seat-operated accounts, and says they cannot be told from a hand in the web UI. Any grade the fleet wrote that way before the relay is now kept as a person's. That is the safe side of 「只要不是车队改的，就是人类改的」, and its size on the open stock is not measured.
- Dev flags left as owed and agreed here as follow-ups, not blockers: `issue-create.mjs` refuses no fleet card missing area, type or grade; the three `scripts/ci` card writers still write the `bug` label and no native type; the objectui rows of `ensure-pm-labels.sh`.

### ④ Design judgment

Per file, against the rulings on epic 35205 and the code each line cites.

- `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`, `AGENTS.md`: hold. Six product areas plus fleet and cloud, security in the private channel, the new cell Broken × builders = p1, the security table by who triggers and who gains, the UX rule of 6982581146, repository before area, raised-never-lowered of 6982729847, p1 ahead of every area, no demotion on pause. The plan document behind "word for word on every grade cell" is not in the input set; the cells were checked against the epic's statements only. Nits N5.
- `filing-gate.md`: the grading section is a pointer and restates no table; the hand-set rule, the current-values rule and the provenance rule match 6982855148 and 6982933281. Findings S1, S3; nits N1, N6, N8.
- `triage-duties.md`: first touch reviews area, type, grade and `Source:`; the daily backstop sentence is the one `first-touch-sweep.mjs` pins; disjunct ⑤ keeps a person's grade. Findings S1; nits N2, N4.
- `execution-duties.md`, `coordinator.md`, `area-lease.md`, `dispatch-runbook.md`, `lanes/triage.md`, `lanes/director.md`, `seat-lifecycle.md`: the take order is the north star's rule 3 in every one of them, and no file still names the road table's order, the focus list or `cloud/ROADMAP.md` row order as an order of work. The scope-review block names a tier constant and no model. Nits N2, N3, N9.
- `SKILL.md`, `state-machine.md`: no demotion on hold; the stock `Restart-grade:` tail is still honoured, and no script reads that line. Finding S1 (the `area:*` row); nit N9.
- `lanes/spec.md`, `lanes/skills.md`, `l1-review-checklist.md`, `decision-analysis.md`: hold as edited. Nit N1 (`decision-analysis.md`:49, untouched, now contradicted).
- `lanes/cloud.md`, `lanes/hotcrm.md`: finding S2.
- `label-write.mjs`: agrees with `filing-gate.md`:33-34 sentence by sentence. Only `labeled` events are read; the newest one of each carried grade decides; no event, an unanswered read and a read past ten pages all refuse; a first grade and a write that touches no grade read nothing. Attempts to break it: a regrade that adds a second grade, a removal alone, a newest event on a later page, an `unlabeled` event by a user, the relay transport — each is refused or passed as the rule says. Finding S3 (the exit it prints); nit N6.
- `fleet-write/*`, `first-touch-sweep.mjs`, `check-half-states.mjs`, `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, `ensure-pm-labels.sh`, the `axis` fields: agree with the contract. The 16 `axis` values are each one of the six product areas and follow where the north star places most of that file's rows. Nits N2, N7.

Findings:

S1 (should-fix) — **Who sets the grade and the type on a fleet-filed card is said two ways.** `filing-gate.md`:32 (new) says a card the fleet files carries area, type, grade and the grade line at filing, "缺一拒收", which is ruling 6982676622 item 1. Standing lines say the opposite and were left: `cross-repo-coordination.md`:4 and :34 (triage is the only producer of type and grade on the multi-lane repository), `lanes/objectstack.md`:10 (first touch and grading stay with triage), `lanes/qa.md`:26 (a defect card the QA seat files is not graded), and two lines of this diff: `SKILL.md`:128 (`area:*` is applied by triage at first touch) and `lanes/hotcrm.md`:12 (a platform card's type belongs to triage). The comment in `ensure-pm-labels.sh` says a filer "may pre-apply". A QA seat or a hotcrm seat that follows its own charter files a card the gate says is refused. Card 35207 asked for the text to change wherever it contradicts these rulings. Also unsaid: who refuses, and how a filer sets the type when the relay's `issue_create` takes none.

S2 (should-fix) — **`lanes/cloud.md` and `lanes/hotcrm.md` point at files that are not on their repositories' `main`.** By the dev's own report, cloud's `docs/strategy/triage-rules.md` and `docs/strategy/core-functions.md`, and hotcrm's `docs/PRIORITIES.md` and one of the three `AGENTS.md` sections, arrive with other pull requests. Landing this head first leaves the cloud lane's first-touch, grading, take-order, enterprise and security-card rules, and hotcrm's scope, compatibility and release rules, with no text on any `main`; `lanes/skills.md` itself says a cut whose content has no home elsewhere is a lost rule. The three CI-minute lines removed from `lanes/cloud.md` are named by neither pointer. Closes without a head move: the target files are on their `main` (and carry the CI-minute rules or the maintainer drops them), or the maintainer accepts the gap in words on the epic. Other repositories were not read for this record.

S3 (should-fix) — **The disagreement route parks the card.** `filing-gate.md`:35, and the refusal sentence `label-write.mjs` prints, send a seat that disagrees with a hand-set grade to `pm:awaiting-maintainer`. `SKILL.md`:119 defines that label as "the decision is made, one action outside GitHub is left", exclusive with every other pm state, not dispatched and not chased; the write tool enforces the exclusivity (`refuseTwoStates`). So a card the maintainer raised by hand leaves `pm:queue` or `pm:dispatched`, and loses its assignee, the moment a seat questions the grade: the opposite of what raising it meant. The route is the one 6982855148 item 2 proposed, so this is put to the maintainer with the merge: either the label is the intended carrier and `SKILL.md`:119 and `state-machine.md`:38-39 say so, or the disagreement is a comment that leaves the card's state alone.

Nits (no effect on this head's correctness; follow-up card or accepted deviation, carrier card 35215 unless said):

- N1 — `decision-analysis.md`:49 (a platform card filed out of an application-repository ruling takes the ruled card's priority) stands beside `filing-gate.md`:64 (no inheritance except a blocked p1). They differ for a ruled card below p1.
- N2 — `pm:blocking`: `SKILL.md`:121 and the north star say a card carries it only when the card it blocks is in an area being dispatched. `triage-duties.md`:38-39 still adds it from H14 for any open dependent, `execution-duties.md`:56 removes it when every dependent closes, the label description still reads "open card with open dependents", and `H67_SELECTION_ORDER_LABELS` in `check-half-states.mjs` still ranks it above p1 and cites the retired 功能点位次 leg. No dispatched-area record exists for a script to read. The label no longer orders anything, so the effect is a label carried more widely than its definition.
- N3 — `execution-duties.md`:50-51 keep a clause and a definition of "开放" from the retired hold rule; :58 orders a tie by non-fleet, then Bug, then age, where the north star says the card opened first goes first.
- N4 — `triage-duties.md`:59 says the p3 first-touch closing standard wins over every non-closing line; :69 says a fleet-sourced Feature, now p3 by rule, is never closed automatically. Which wins is not said.
- N5 — `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`: "UX has no p3" sits beside a fleet-sourced UX Feature at p3 (the first means a UX problem); "pre-authorised" is used and defined only in `triage-duties.md`; a non-UX Feature from a maintainer or topic source has no default grade, though a fleet-filed card must carry one; "an anchor card takes no grade" beside `triage-duties.md`:26-30, which grades a main-red anchor p0; rule 3 ② lets a p1 in a held area jump the queue while `seat-lifecycle.md`:60 puts `pm:on-hold` on the children of a paused sub-epic.
- N6 — The `Ruling-ref:` exit is written in the tool and its refusal, not in `filing-gate.md`, which says only that the grade is not changed. Any `Ruling-ref:` line passes, and the key is shared with two other uses (`triage-duties.md`:34, `dispatch-runbook.md`:146). The guard judges `label-write.mjs` alone; a relay actions file with `labels_add` and `labels_remove` is not judged, as the header says.
- N7 — `lacksArea` exempts a `security`-labelled card on every repository, and cloud has `area:security`; a cloud security card with no area is never listed.
- N8 — The duty "L1 and L2 send back a citation that reads as temporary or was said to one seat" lives in `filing-gate.md`:24 with a pointer from `lanes/skills.md`. `contract-review.md` and the review brief carry no such line, so an isolated reviewer is not told. Carrier: a skills card for the brief template.
- N9 — `pm:epic` now means both a sub-epic only the maintainer opens (`SKILL.md`:125, `seat-lifecycle.md`:54) and the reservation of the `epic:#n` exception (`seat-post-protocol.md`:71-74, `seat-lifecycle.md`:64), in one row.

The security line above reads yes because changed hunks teach how security problems are graded and where they are recorded (the security table, the private channel, the `security` label setting no grade). No mechanism is described in the diff or in this record.

  - The fleet-Feature line (p3, UX included) and the triage lines on pre-authorised Features and the weekly list (never dispatched without pre-authorisation, no decision card, never auto-closed) agree with north-star line 139.

The `pm:blocking` bullet (「依赖者全关即摘」) is back word for word at `execution-duties.md:56`. 「无级末位是分诊缺口」 survives as 「无级/无 area/无 type 轮报记分诊缺口」 in the same file.
